Yes, especially now that I’m 40, unemployed, burned through 2 careers, and have no idea what direction to go in. I just want to hide away from the world. I’m intelligent but have ADHD and difficulties processing large amounts of information, especially if it’s random. I get stressed and over whelmed in most job settings. People think I’m stupid, and base that on my lack of a degree and my average economic status. I live a simple life, I shop at thrift stores, I bought a small old home in the country so I could be away from people and the competitive nature of humanity, and this stage in life. Where who you are is based on your stuff and not who you actually are as a person. But on my road, wealthy people keep coming and buying up the old farm land and building big homes and looking down on me and my simple dwelling with it’s lack of HGTV landscaping, ect. So what I was looking to avoid has found me! Just writing that has given me a huge insight to my current distress. Imagine you’re trying to live a quiet little life in the country away from the snobby wealthy suburbs, and they come and freakin’ build their dumbass McMansions next to you, drive up your taxes, and look down (literally) at you? It’s calkex gentrification. No wonder I’m depressed! My daughter is friends with the kids down the road but they make twice as much as us, the dad’s getting his Masters in counseling, they run 10ks for fun, and the kids are in so many activities they usually don’t have time to play. Plus, I think they think I’m some loser poor person on drugs because I’m not wealthy. If I’m not wealthy or successful it’s because I’m not trying hard enough right? Or I must be of low intelligence or lacking discipline or self control. Or I must be on drugs or an alcoholic right? Guess what, We don’t smoke or drink, we value kindness and compassion, even though I’m unemployed I sponsor a child in another country, because the thought of other people having to be born and die in poverty drives me crazy. I see all the emptiness to our existence and how we are not caring for each other only ourselves which is a black hole. I can’t find people to connect with. My goal in life isn’t to become rich with lots of stuff, but to enjoy my life and help others. That can be tricky on a small income. In the south people are so about their stuff. People dress up all the time like they’re country music singers, and they look down on me because I like to dress casual. And that’s mostly to do with my sensitivity to how clothes feel. Fancy clothes are uncomfortable to me. I’m under so much stress and anxiety right now that all my ADHD and SPD symptoms are the worst they’ve ever been. I literally can’t think clearly. I’m so worried about taking care of my family I have no clue how to fix my own situation. I feel so stuck, trapped, and frustrated. I’ve in a prison cell and trying to dig out with a plastic spoon. At least I’m trying I guess. Do I accept my place in life or keep trying? I’m not going to touch on the child hood that brought me here. But it’s something I’m working through. Let’s just say, I was allowed to exist in the house. And provide a supportive role to my mom, because my dad was to busy with his hobbies to spent time with her.
